thesis: Unchanged from 8 September, with the macro now decided against it. Bitcoin is still range-bound at $77,353 with RSI 48 and no breakout, and the Fed is priced to hike after a 3.4% CPI print. The one thing that changed this week is that the flows story rotated to Ether - ETH ETFs took $189.15M in a day while bitcoin had an outflow day - which removes the argument that made BTC the best horse in this sleeve.
bull_case: The structural bid is still there. US spot bitcoin ETFs took $3.52B in August, their strongest month of 2026, and $986.9M in the week ended 4 September, with combined net assets of $103.34B, about 6.32% of market cap. The long-term trend holds: close > SMA50 > SMA200, 63d momentum +20.5%, ATR 2.9% - still the calmest crypto we own. The position is only -1.7% and the $77k area has absorbed repeated tests without breaking.
bear_case: The reason to prefer BTC over the alts was that flows were consolidating into it. That has reversed: spot Ether ETFs saw their largest daily inflow since October 2025 at $189.15M on a day bitcoin funds saw outflows, and ETH is up 27% in seven days while bitcoin slipped from $81k to $77.4k. Price is going nowhere - RSI 48, no breakout flag, a $77-82k range it has failed to clear - and it dragged the whole complex lower on 10 September. August CPI landed this morning and settled the argument: headline +0.4% m/m and 3.4% year on year, core +0.3% m/m against a 0.2% estimate, with gasoline up 3.9% and accounting for over a third of the monthly increase. Hike odds for 15-16 Sep jumped on the print - sources put them anywhere from ~69% to 85-90%, but every one of them agrees the direction is a hike being priced. The fed funds rate has sat at 3.5-3.75% all year. Base rate from our own backtest (research/backtests/2026-09-06.md): the crypto sleeve returned -6.4% with Sharpe -0.15 and a 17% win rate over 75 trades. No demonstrated edge in crypto momentum in this system.
catalysts: 15-16 Sep 2026 FOMC decision and dot plot
Weekly US spot bitcoin ETF flow prints and whether the ETH rotation persists
risks: Flows rotating from BTC to ETH
Range-bound $77-82k with RSI 48 and no breakout
Hike priced for 16 Sep after a 3.4% CPI print
Own backtest: no demonstrated edge in crypto momentum
invalidation: Unchanged from 8 Sep: flips long on a daily close above 82,000 made after the FOMC with ETF flows positive. The bear case confirms on a close below 74,000, which breaks the range low and the SMA50.
